=== Thin Webbing ===
'''Thin Webbing''' is a [[Blocks|block]] produced by [[Assimilated Big Spider|Assimilated Big Spiders]], [[Primitive Arachnida|Primitive]] and [[Adapted Arachnida]], [[Assimara Bear|Assimara Bears]], and [[Airscrew|Airscrews]]. It only affects mobs which are not parasites and will disappear after some time.

=== Toxicant Webbing ===
'''Toxicant Webbing''' is a [[Blocks|block]] produced by [[Monarch|Monarchs]]. If a mob is caught in one, it will receive periodic damage until it either manages to escape or dies. It only affects mobs which are not parasites and will disappear after some time.

=== Tarnished Webbing ===
'''Tarnished Webbing''' is a [[Blocks|block]] not obtainable in survival. If a mob is caught in one, it will receive periodic damage, more so than Toxicant Webbing, until it either manages to escape or dies. It only affects mobs which are not parasites.
